name: Doumyouji Akihiko
source: A mysterious person who brings strange cases to the protagonist. He claims to be a detective from the MPD, but each time he appears he gives a different title and affiliation, making his true identity unknown.
translation: A mysterious person who brings strange cases to the protagonist. He claims to be a detective from the MPD, but each time he appears he gives a different title and affiliation, making his true identity unknown.
